selection: pre-existing deterministic task index 6 sentiment, eight selected cases; identical cases in both arms; no redraw
protocol: Prospective multiclass extension of own-slice transfer test, not a literal binary replication or same-protocol claim. Compile separate native-label and semantic-unsure programs before case evaluation. Native arm labels negative, neutral, positive; semantic arm labels negative, neutral, positive, UNSURE. Normalize first-token confidence across three native labels via softmax of maximum logits of each label space/no-space token variants, requiring disjoint token sets. Capture token IDs and raw logits and outputs. Each case once per arm; no redraw. Thresholds 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99.
rule: TRANSFER_SUPPORTED iff all 16 arm/case observations complete, semantic invalid count zero, semantic decided count >= 6 of 8 and semantic decided exact-match accuracy >= 0.90; semantic unsure rate <= 0.25. Otherwise TRANSFER_NOT_SHOWN if observations complete, INCOMPLETE if any missing. Separately report native-label threshold coverage and accuracy; no asserted threshold superiority on n=8. Higher decided accuracy is better; lower unsure rate is better.
